category_title: Active and vocal students during teacher-led instruction
minimal_context: The student is working on a mathematics worksheet involving triangles and their sides during a teacher-directed lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's move on to the next mathematics problem on the worksheet involving triangles and their sides.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can answer that! I've been getting all the triangle questions right so far.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay. Go ahead and try the more challenging question at the bottom of the page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Oh, this one looks a lot harder. I don't know if I remember how to find the missing side.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should do?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know, I'm starting to doubt myself on this. I can't do these harder ones unless someone tells me I'm doing it right and says positive things to encourage me.
